public.text: The draft favours assistive AI and meaningful human oversight, but does not define non-delegable professional responsibilities or controlled write-back rules. Generated summaries, recommendations and inferred data may become indistinguishable from source facts if written back without explicit status, review and accountability.
public.suggestedRevision: State that probabilistic or generated content must not silently overwrite authoritative source information or become indistinguishable from professionally verified facts. Require output provenance, model/version, timestamp, intended user and action, uncertainty, validation status, reviewing professional, audit history, override/correction and supersession. Identify non-delegable responsibilities proportionate to risk, including professional judgement, ethical reasoning, contextual interpretation, escalation, final authorisation where required, and accountability for material clinical-record changes.
